subject.title: [Feature]: Detect Containerized Environments and Disable Update Suggestions

question: Should detected container environments suppress explicit update.auto.enabled and manual update.run/Control UI update actions, or only replace passive update suggestions?
rationale: Changing stored auto-update behavior and manual update availability is an upgrade-sensitive product policy choice, not a purely mechanical code repair.

options.title: Complete container update policy
options.body: Gate or replace passive hints and manual update actions in detected containers, document the chosen auto-update behavior, rebase over current main, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Accept automatic suppression
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that detected containers override update availability and explicit auto-update settings, but the policy should be documented and tested before landing.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94279 remains the policy tracker and avoid merging partial behavior.

recommendation.title: Complete container update policy
recommendation.body: Gate or replace passive hints and manual update actions in detected containers, document the chosen auto-update behavior, rebase over current main, and require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from update feature history and project/product ownership listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
